filing_office: Mississippi Secretary of State, Business Services
filing_fee_notes: Domestic LLC formation fee is 50; its annual report has no state filing fee.
registered_agent_rules: Designate an individual, corporation or LLC with a physical Mississippi address to act as registered agent.
plain_english_summary: File a Certificate of Formation and designate a Mississippi registered agent. File the free annual report online.
common_mistake: Assuming no annual-report fee means no annual-report requirement.
notes: Domestic LLC scope; foreign LLC report fees differ. Annual-report URL is the official gateway. Direct formation and name-search URLs, first-report-year rule, formation processing time, expedite options, applicable franchise-tax treatment, publication and operating-agreement requirement were not confirmed and are null.
